thesis: Dependence on components does not make every higher-level explanation dispensable.
role: Distinguishes reduction, organization and justified emergence.

ideas.statement: Ontological and methodological reduction do not entail explanatory replacement.
Collective laws can be robust precisely because they omit microscopic detail; their success cannot uniquely recover the substrate.
Organization and constraints matter without extra substances; possible complexity differs from its typical production.
Biological persistence is not moral value, and institutions change what behavior is rewarded.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A repeated cooperation game changes the costs of betrayal relative to one round.
Renormalization illustrates stable relations across different components.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Infinite-lattice limits do not prohibit every finite calculation; naming emergence is not explaining it.

audit.notes: Every unit read; metaphysical commitments separated from empirical findings.
